LIVE_EVIDENCE_BATCH_2 2026-05-24:

ACLI INTEGRATION HARDENING - 4 confirmed-fixed bugs + sanitizers + contract test suite all on origin/main:

  - 4fa9-0846-519e-4c30 (ProjectKey-null): FIXED in PR #333; commit on main 26ac574985.
  - 5010-1c6a-9387-4b5b (priority dict shape): FIXED in PR #334; commit on main 5f5d4963e2.
  - c916-74a1-ed06-40e4 (add_label uses nonexistent --label flag): FIXED in PR #335; commit on main 56ed89083c. add_label rewritten to --from-json with labelsToAdd, --yes. New remove_label counterpart added. Both empirically verified against live DIG-3802 (additive, idempotent, preserves existing labels).
  - Off-by-one in _JIRA_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS (255 -> 254): FIXED in commit 952f2b7457 (part of PR #335). Verified via independent audit against Atlassian Community thread 989632 + tenable/integration-jira-cloud#322.

ACLI INTEGRATION TEST SUITE: 36 tests in tests/scripts/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py — pins EXACT command shape + payload structure for every confirmed-correct ACLI invocation pattern. Boundary-exact tests for both 255-char label limit (inclusive) and 254-char summary limit (Jira's strict less-than). All 36 GREEN.

INDEPENDENT VALIDATION AUDIT (run a52143da, 2026-05-24): cross-checked 22 ACLI invocation patterns against authoritative Atlassian docs + 20+ GitHub prior-art consumers (rasheedja, redhat-developer/rhdh-skill, jm96441n/dotfiles, doug-skinner/acli-claude-skill, peetzweg/acli-skill, etc.). 21/22 CONFIRMED-CORRECT. The one finding (summary off-by-one) was fixed and shipped in the same PR.

LIVE EMPIRICAL VERIFICATION 2026-05-24T04:38Z against DIG-3802:
  - hardened add_label adds new label without destroying existing ones: PASS
  - re-adding same label is idempotent (no duplicates): PASS
  - hardened remove_label removes target + preserves other labels: PASS
  - _sanitize_label rejects whitespace-containing labels with InvalidLabelError: PASS

  - CC1 (legacy YAMLs deleted + no post-cutover scheduled runs): VERIFIED 2026-05-24 (LIVE_EVIDENCE_BATCH_1).

  - CC4 (weekly-fsck 2 consecutive cycles): VERIFIED 2026-05-24 (LIVE_EVIDENCE_BATCH_1: runs 26350906355 + 26350930124, identical 1738 anomaly counts).
  - CC5 (no legacy refs): VERIFIED 2026-05-24 (cleanup PR #334 merged at 5f5d4963e2; final grep returns 0 non-shim-exempt matches).
  - CC6 (per-pass REST budget, no 429s): PENDING 5-pass observation.
